shared_prompts.photo: Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real material texture and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. No letters, words, numbers, logos or brand marks anywhere, not on signs, screens, clothes, bags, machines or vehicles. A first-time learner must understand the picture instantly on a small phone screen. Every visible hand has five natural fingers. Do not imitate earlier course photos.
shared_prompts.solo: Only this one person is in the photo; there is nobody else, even far in the background.
shared_prompts.daytime: It is clearly daytime with soft natural light.
shared_prompts.near_far_scene: The meaning of the photo is NEAR versus FAR. Exactly two things of the same kind are in the photo, and they differ only in color. The near one is with the person in the left part of the photo, large and sharp. The far one stands alone in the right third of the photo, clearly farther away, against a plain wall with nothing else around it; it is in focus and easy to recognize even on a small phone screen, and its center is about three quarters of the way across the photo, well clear of the right edge. The camera is at chest height and sees the whole scene from the side, so that the space between the person and the far thing runs from left to right across the photo: an arm pointed at the far thing would be seen side-on as a long line across the photo, never pointing toward the camera. The floor and wall between them are plain and empty. There is no mirror, no picture on the wall, no shelf of objects, and no third thing of that kind anywhere.

assets.item: That one is black. / but that bike is black. (turn 2)
assets.prompt: Image 1 shows Luis in a paved courtyard: a white city bike stands close to the camera, and one black city bike leans against the far plain grey wall. Using the same man (same face, short dark curly hair, warm medium-brown skin, navy T-shirt and jeans), the same courtyard, the same white bike and the same black bike, create a NEW photograph from a different camera position. Luis has turned his whole body to FACE the black bike: his feet, hips, chest and shoulders all face it. The camera is behind him and a little to his left, at chest height. His HEAD is turned all the way toward the black bike and tilted down at it, exactly like his arm: from the camera we see the back of his head, his right ear and only the outline of his cheek, nose and eyebrow; his nose and eyes point straight at the black bike, not to the side and not at the wall. His left hand still rests on the saddle of the white bike, which stands right beside him, close to the camera, on the left of the photo. His right arm is stretched straight out in front of him toward the black bike, slightly downward, and his index finger points directly at the black bike: his eyes, his head, his arm and his finger all aim at it along one line. The black bike stands on the ground against the far wall, about five meters in front of his fingertip, in the middle-right of the photo, whole, sharp and easy to see, and nothing is between his finger and the bike. The fingertip stays far from the black bike.

reference_file.observed_description: e05: Luis (navy T-shirt, jeans) behind a white city bike in a paved courtyard, hands on its saddle and handlebar; one black city bike leans on the far plain grey wall.

assets.item: This one is white. / This bike is white, (turn 1)
assets.prompt: Image 1 shows Luis from behind in a courtyard, facing a black bike on the far wall and pointing at it, with his left hand on the saddle of a white bike beside him. Keep the same man, clothes, courtyard, both bikes, the light and the camera position exactly. Change only his head and right arm: he now looks DOWN at the white bike beside him, and his right hand rests on the white bike's handlebar. He no longer points; the black bike stays on the far wall, unchanged.
